contexts.text: There is a trinal dimension of all earthly things; but such dimensions cannot be predicated of celestial and spiritual things: when they are predicated, abstractedly from the dimensions, there is meant greater or less perfection, and also its quality and quantity.
By the dimensions there... are perceived states of good and truth... AC 4489:2.
The reason such things are meant by these three dimensions...
Under Degree, see these references. DLW 190.
1.2. These spaces are varied as to distances and dimensions.
The reason these things are signified by these three dimensions...
By their dimensions is signified their quality.
